competitive_landscape: Fragmented local diesel tour-boat and resort-tender operators. Tropic Air and Maya Island Air dominate the air spoke. No electric / foiling tier exists. The premium resort-tender and Central American extender tiers are both wide open.

journeys.with_navier: Hybrid Quanta-LR cross-border Central American extender on a ~80 nm corridor with no charging-infrastructure dependency. Longer-horizon — partner channels in development.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Pioneer II owns the southern tour-tender tier — Placencia↔Ranguana (~18 nm), Placencia↔Laughing Bird Caye (~11 nm), Placencia↔Silk Caye (~15 nm) — all inside the 70 nm all-electric envelope on protected reef water.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Hybrid Quanta-LR is the longer-horizon Central American extender — Placencia↔Roatán / Utila (~80 nm) and Placencia↔Belize City (~75 nm direct corridor connector) — with no charging-infrastructure dependency.

precedents.why_it_matters: Placencia anchors the southern spoke off the northern Belize corridor — pairs natively with the Belize City build.

regulatory_note: Belize Port Authority + Belize Tourism Board. Laughing Bird Caye National Park (UNESCO WHS component) and Glover's Reef Marine Reserve give clean quiet-mode regulatory anchors. UNESCO Belize Barrier Reef Reserve System.
seasonality: Year-round operability; dry season (December–April) is peak resort tourism, wet season (June–November) brings occasional tropical-storm windows but the lagoon-side water stays workable.

summary: Placencia is Belize's southern peninsula resort hub and gateway to the southern cayes and atolls (Ranguana, Silk Caye, Laughing Bird, Glover's Reef staging). Protected lagoon-side water and a growing luxury-resort base; lower volume than the northern Cayes corridor but anchors a southern spoke. Pioneer II quiet-mode tour-tender tier into the southern atolls plus resort-transfer demand off the Placencia peninsula.
tagline: Southern Belize resort hub + gateway to Ranguana, Silk Caye and the southern atolls — protected lagoon-side foiling water.
